text:
zoe (Design): quick sync — thinking about where the preflight/connectivity checks should live in the Private setup wizard. current mock puts it as a full-width step between "Network" and "Finalize". some feedback said it feels heavy and interrupts the flow. thoughts?

rahul (UX): i saw that. two options: a) keep it as a dedicated step (big card) so users don't miss it; b) collapse into the final review as a compact checklist row with an optional expand for details. my lean: compact checklist for speed, expandable for debugging.

marta (Eng): from infra side, the probe can be quick or take up to ~30s in bad networks. if it's a heavy step it stalls the wizard. compact makes sense but we need a clear place for logs and retry. we return `probe_summary` + `probe_logs_url` when checks run.

li (Product): product perspective: critical customers want the preflight early so they can fix infra before committing. maybe surface a short checklist at top of the wizard (3 bullets) and then an optional "Run connectivity checks" card inline where users can run the probe. that way we both warn and don't block. defaults: ON for hosted, OFF for private.

zoe (Design): UI idea: show a slim prereq banner at the top with 3 bullets (Outbound egress to Redwood IPs, Bastion reachable:22, Optional: HTTP 80/443). each bullet has a subtle status dot (unknown/ok/fail). when user expands, show the full probe card with per-probe chips (TCP  SSH  HTTP) + primary CTA(s).

rahul (UX): accessibility notes: the expand action must be keyboard accessible and set aria-expanded. when probe runs, use role=status live polite announcing "Connectivity checks running" and final summary. if a chip fails, set focus to the chip's inline link "View troubleshooting" and SR should announce the failure summary. avoid focus traps — let users escape back to the form.

marta (Eng): implementation: we'll add `probe_mode` flag (hosted|manual) and `probe_details` array (label, status, short_reason). also can host raw logs behind a signed short-lived URL. local-run option will generate a signed script that posts to the same URL. note: probe is IPv4 only for now — annotate for IPv6-only customers.

li (Product): copy debate: should CTA read "Run connectivity checks" or "Verify connectivity"? shorter verb might be clearer: "Verify connectivity (recommended)". also decision on primary/secondary — for hosted primary=Run from Redwood, secondary=Download local probe. for private primary=Download local probe, secondary=Run from Redwood (so we don't assume permission).
\elevated-comment (Design): nina? (this is me — inline) i'd like microcopy options.

zoe (Design): microcopy options:
1) Short/explicit:
"Verify connectivity (recommended)"
"Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from its health-checker IPs to the host and port you supply. No credentials or commands are sent. If you cannot allow our IPs, download the local probe to run inside your network."

2) Minimal:
"Run connectivity checks"
"We will try to connect from Redwood health-checker IPs. No credentials are transmitted."

3) Reassuring with CTA split:
"Run connectivity checks (recommended) — Redwood will attempt a TCP handshake. No credentials are sent. [Run from Redwood] [Run locally]"

rahul (UX): prefer option 1 in the UI copy. for aria-describedby use the full sentence but keep visual copy short. aria example: "Verify connectivity. Redwood will attempt a TCP handshake from its health-checker IPs. No credentials or commands are sent."

marta (Eng): security note: logs will include target host and probe IPs; we'll scrub any token-like patterns. local script will only upload handshake outcomes, not configs. i'll post the CIDR list and a one-paragraph privacy blurb in this thread when ready.

li (Product): layout question: where to show probe status after user navigates away? options: a) keep final pass/fail on the wizard breadcrumb (green/red dot) b) persistent toast c) dashboard notification. i vote breadcrumb + a small "View details" link so the wizard remains discoverable.

rahul (UX): breadcrumb dot + details panel is good. for mobile, use an inline accordion; avoid toasts that disappear. also ensure color isn't the only indicator; add textual status "Connectivity: Failed".

zoe (Design): final UX asks before i mock: - compact prereq banner at top - expandable full probe card inline - per-probe chips with statuses and "View troubleshooting" links - primary CTA choice per deployment type - privacy link under the control. anyone object?

marta (Eng): no objections. i'll add `probe_summary` + `probe_logs_url` and the CIDR ranges today. also will flag IPv6 limitation in the API response.

infra-bot: staging deploy scheduled for 2025-11-21T07:00Z — heads up. :rocket:

li (Product): great — i'll update the spec and call out defaults + breadcrumb behavior. zoe, ping when mocks are ready and rahul for ARIA proofread. thanks!
